the best approach to forecasting financial market variables is to integrate the best features of both approaches.

financial econometrics and big data/machine learning are complementary, not conflicting.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the tools of financial econometricians are not obsolete with the advent of machine learning; rather, they are critical in answering questions of inference among the variables and their relationships in financial markets.

the best computational models for financial applications are those that are able to integrate financial theory, market characteristics, and the best features of machine learning and financial econometrics.

the tools of financial econometric modeling remain critical in understanding and answering questions related to the inference of relationships among variables that describe the economic relationships in finance.
